scope: scripts/qualify_plcsim_diagnostics.py on Debug builds of 4f4c3cdc (artifacts/ts1, git archive) with one owned PLCSIM Advanced V8 CPU1511 instance on Softbus and one owned TIA Portal V21. runtime_capture with source plcsim, cycleSynchronous and each syncMode, two signals, 100 ms interval, 2 s duration: the new TimespanSynchronized_C and TimespanSynchronized_CP (spanMilliseconds 10, each sample StartProcessing of 10 ms CPU time to the next sync point) captured 40 rows to their duration limit; TimespanSynchronized_P captured 2 rows and ended sessionUnavailable, as SingleStep_P does on this OB1-only fixture without a process-image partition. SingleStep_C/CP/CT/CPT reran (40/40/30/31 rows) and SingleStep_P stalled after 2. Every capture restored the previous operating mode Default. A time-synchronised mode without spanMilliseconds was refused before any capture intent. The rest of the PLCSIM diagnostics corpus passed unchanged.
limitations: One CPU1511 fixture whose only cyclic OB is OB1 with the automatic process image; the P modes stall without a process-image partition. Rows are not compared with CPU time or scan counts.
One span (10 ms); other spans and scale factors are not exercised.
